A '''hezar stone''' was a valuable [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]]. A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] encountered an [[Unidentified sentient avian species|avian species]] that rewarded them with sacks of hezar stones for saving a member of their tribe.
